notes.title: Linux version updated
notes.notes:
Fixed some Linux-specific issues.
Support for the game controllers added.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Missions at the Hard level has been adjusted: 7 super-tough missions became easier.
Fixed bug with Alt-Tab in full screen mode.

notes.title: New version - 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6 introduces basic support for gamepad control - useful for the Big Picture mode :)
Also some bugs with card descriptions translation were fixed.
This version is built over the new release of the open Apus Game Engine - [url=https://github.com/Cooler2/ApusGameEngine/tree/Engine4-r1]Engine4[/url] and now uses SDL2 library for cross-platform system management and input devices support.

notes.title: Mixing strategy, puzzles and cards 'Astral Towers' comes to Linux with the latest update
notes.notes:
Combining together a turn-based card game that needs strategy and a little puzzle solving, Astral Towers along with the open source game engine powering it comes to Linux.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/03/mixing-strategy-puzzles-and-cards-astral-towers-comes-to-linux-with-the-latest-update

notes.title: Linux version released
notes.notes:
Astral Towers game now works natively on both Linux and Windows. This is because Linux support was added to the Apus Game Engine - the engine powered Astral Towers game. 

The game source code is available to all engine's patrons on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/ApusGameEngine. So you can become a patron and build the game from source :-) It can be compiled with either Delphi Community Edition or Lazarus / FPC (both are free) for Linux or Windows.

The engine itself is open source and available at GitHub.
